full_judgment: 2. Facts the case, in short, are that one Jalil, Assistant Commissioner, Land (Bhola) Sadar, being informant lodged an allegation to the Deputy Commissioner, Bhola against the accused Rafiqul Islam, alleging, inter alia, that the accused Rafiqul Islam was the Surveyor from 8.11.1987 to 7.8.1990 in his department, he even after transfer did not handover the charge to new Surveyor, Polin Behari, the accused person kept Khatian book of Shitaram Mouza in his own custody but while it was required, the Assistant Commissioner (Land) along with other office staffs went to his house and subsequently found that there were some settlement cases which appeared to be forged. Thereafter it was seized and the complainant also found that all the signatures of the official staffs were also forged. The accused Rafiqul Islam for the purpose of wrongful gain created those false documents. The aforesaid allegation was subsequently referred to Bhola Police Station and the same was recorded as Bhola Police Station Case No.7 dated 15.8.1990 showing Md. Faruq Jalil being informant and the accused petitioner and others as accused persons, hence the case.
